name: stott_security_app
description: OCP app providing CSP and response header management for Optimizely CMS (SaaS).
//packageManager: The OCP builder reads this to decide which manager runs build/lint/test. The scaffolded template ships `yarn clean` in its build script even when scaffolded with --package-manager npm, which fails in the build image. Scripts below use npm run, or call binaries directly (manager-agnostic).

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build --config vite.backend.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.ui.config.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && cross-env LOG_LEVEL=NEVER ocp-app-sdk validate

//dependencies: @optimizely/ocp-cms-ui-extensions-sdk is PINNED to 1.0.0-beta.4. The template ships `latest`, which resolves to 1.0.0-beta.1 — that version declares UI_EXTENSION_INJECTION_POINTS as ['sidebar'] only and REJECTS the 'view' (full page) surface this app depends on. Do not relax to latest or ^ without re-checking dist/AppManifest.d.ts.
